current_objective: Complete the universal ORBYVEN 1.0 core UX: onboarding, global search, universal create, custom fields, configurable tags/statuses and reusable templates while preserving beginner-friendly three-click behavior.
last_completed: Bootstrap PR #353 was verified current and green across ORBYVEN CI, Architecture Guard and Quality Gate, then merged into canonical main.

Current-main audit found onboarding already implemented in app/workspace/onboarding with guarded workspace entry, explicit bootstrap confirmation, responsive module selection and entitlement-aware checkout defaults.

Current-main audit found tenant-scoped global record search already implemented in components/WorkspaceSearch.tsx for enabled leads/tasks/estimates/inventory with organization_id filtering, wildcard escaping and exact record navigation.
Current-main audit found Universal Create already implemented in WorkspaceShell: enabled-module filtering, viewer denial, finance role gating and create-intent navigation into module forms.

Current-main audit found no standalone Command Palette implementation; WorkspaceSearch exposes an optional onOpenCommands hook but WorkspaceShell does not wire it. This is the first demonstrably missing atomic capability.

No dedicated universal custom-field foundation, configurable tag/status manager, or reusable workspace-record template foundation was found in the current component/lib inventory; public website template catalogs are separate concerns and will not be reused wholesale.
next_action: Implement an isolated, reusable Command Palette component plus pure command-building/filtering contract on this current-main branch. It must consume existing module/i18n/create contracts, filter by enabled modules and role, perform navigation/create intents only (no direct mutation), support Ctrl/Cmd+K and keyboard navigation, and avoid editing WorkspaceShell/global navigation/providers/module registry. Add targeted regression coverage; coordinator will perform shared-shell integration after the atomic PR is green.

tests.notes: Capability audit complete. Implementation and targeted verification are next.
